limitations: Full Bitcoin consensus/script validation remains deferred.

No final-source full Windows Go-suite rerun is claimed. Earlier Windows full-suite evidence and final focused/native checks remain separately scoped.
Historical received totals cover explicit creation ranges and do not establish current balance or complete transaction history.
Balances exclude mempool activity and do not imply wallet ownership or spendability.
Sats, inscription holdings, snapshot/state exchange and Gateway peerhood remain gated in Addresses.
Windows client and installer binaries are not Authenticode signed. Installer wizard, OS/browser registration and antivirus/SmartScreen acceptance are not established by payload audits.
The hosted automatic-upgrade fixture contains full headers and saved policy, not a complete historical TXIO/UTXO profile; separate genuine early-chain address checks cover saved UTXO reuse.
Hosted checks used disposable profiles and a warmed publisher; idle cold-start latency was not measured.
The newer-Sat compatibility guard preserves evidence by retaining additional facts; it does not convert incompatible experimental Sat state.
Successful renewal commissioning does not guarantee future scheduled execution.
